verdict.rationale: Docs show the full server-driven flow: create applicant → create workflow run (returns SDK token) → collect captures via SDK or Smart Capture Link (hosted/drop-in, low/no-code) → retrieve results via webhook or polling, matching the story closely. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration beyond vendor docs, and explicit example of a redirect-based hosted URL flow versus only SDK/Smart Capture Link.
